# Immunities

Make any monster immune to instant death, polymorph, petrification or Feeblemind, as vanilla `charmres` does for charm.

These go after `newmonster` or `selectmonster`. A `0` after a command takes that immunity off: `killres 0`. `copystats` copies none of them (for now).

### killres, polymorphres, petrifyres, feebleres <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #immunities .command data-toc-label="Immunities" data-added="2.12" data-toc-rows="killres polymorphres petrifyres feebleres" }

A caster skips the monster for a spell that `killres`, `polymorphres` or `petrifyres` stops. A polymorphed unit has its new monster's immunities, so `killres`, `petrifyres` and `feebleres` need `polymorphres` to last.

| Command | What it stops | Unit stats screen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="killres"></span>`killres` | A spell or monster attack with damage of exactly 999, like Finger of Death and Soul Slay | Instant Death Immunity |
| <span id="polymorphres"></span>`polymorphres` | A polymorph weapon's hit (`dmgtype 15`), like Polymorph into Frog | Polymorph Immunity |
| <span id="petrifyres"></span>`petrifyres` | A petrify weapon's hit (`dmgtype 24`), like Petrifying Gaze | Petrification Immunity |
| <span id="feebleres"></span>`feebleres` | Feeblemind from a battle wound or a special affliction weapon (`dmgtype 12`), but not from an event's `makeaff` or a ritual's `afftarg` | Feeblemind Immunity |

### Example monster { #example }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    selectmonster "Witch-king of Angmar"
    killres
    polymorphres
    petrifyres
    feebleres
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    selectmonster "Witch-king of Angmar"
    #!@killres
    #!@polymorphres
    #!@petrifyres
    #!@feebleres
    ```
